displayName: PVACD pipeline: staleness (no successful run in 24h)

documentation.content:
No `pvacd-daily` Cloud Workflows execution has finished with status `SUCCEEDED` in the last 24 hours.

This is the data-**freshness** signal: the daily batch is expected to land a new partition every day, so a full day with no successful run means downstream FROST data is going stale even if no single run threw a hard error (e.g. the Scheduler job is paused, or every attempt is silently retried out).

**Note:** this keys off Workflow success and needs no application change. For per-partition freshness (age of the newest `dt` actually loaded to FROST), add the optional log-based metric described in `monitoring/README.md`.

**Triage:** check Cloud Scheduler (is the `pvacd-daily` job enabled and firing?) and the most recent Workflow executions.

conditionAbsent.filter: resource.type = "workflows.googleapis.com/Workflow" AND metric.type = "workflows.googleapis.com/finished_execution_count" AND metric.labels.status = "SUCCEEDED" AND resource.labels.workflow_id = "pvacd-daily"
